title: 2023 National Rally to Demand the Return of the Northern Territories
reason: The captured Prime Minister’s Office result describes a government-attended official rally demanding action from Russia over the Northern Territories, not a protest demanding action from Japan’s own state. It is not coded as an eligible anti-state protest.
notes: Search-result evidence only; no attendance estimate or body was captured. External target and official government attendance are grounds for excluding this lead, not proof that no other protest occurred that day.
